assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Raises when the stage-by-stage reconstruction's fragment_component or valid differs from the whole topology.read output. It compares two independently computed outputs of the code under test (the split path against the whole path), not a value against the same input the test supplied, so it would redden if a stage were mis-sequenced or a fused path diverged. It is a real guard, but it lives in a prototype script run by hand, not in a test, so no suite runs it.

Raises when the standalone component-label call's output differs from the read's fragment_component. Same independent-comparison shape as the first; it would redden on a label regression, but is reachable only when measure.py is run by hand.

The report is a measurement node's deliverable and adds no assertion over its published numbers (exponents, shares, the 81.315 s total). Nothing reddens if the receipts are regenerated with different numbers and the prose is not updated.
